designationHistory.indexText: The Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved the UL Bend refuge on February 7, 1967, before the 1969 land order formally established it.

sources.name: FWS, CCP: Charles M. Russell and UL Bend NWRs (2012), chronology

review.by: Accepted on the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's own record (Library decision)

designationHistory.indexText: The Interior Department established the UL Bend National Wildlife Refuge in Montana by Public Land Order 4588, dated March 25, 1969, which withdrew the lands from the Fort Peck Game Range for the refuge.

authority.citation: Public Land Order 4588 (34 FR 5851), revoking in part Executive Order 7509

designationHistory.note: Pass A (2012 CCP chronology: PLO 4588 of 03/25/1969 designated the refuge) and Pass B (PLO text in the Federal Register of March 28, 1969, titled "Establishment of the UL Bend National Wildlife Refuge," signed by the Acting Secretary of the Interior and dated March 25, 1969) agree. The FWS ServCat record misdates the PLO as May 25, 1969 in one field.

sources.name: Federal Register, vol. 34, no. 60 (Mar. 28, 1969), Public Land Order 4588, "Establishment of the UL Bend National Wildlife Refuge"
